hero.title: Learn Entrepreneurship Through Games & Simulations
hero.subtitle: EZPlay transforms business concepts into interactive experiences. Make real decisions, manage resources, and develop your leadership skills.

founderLoop.title: Founder Loop — Your Growth Cycle
founderLoop.subtitle: How you learn and advance in the EZPlay ecosystem through clear developmental steps.
founderLoop.step1Desc: Participate in intense team-based business simulations. Make production, marketing, and financial decisions.
founderLoop.step2Desc: Analyze the results of the round. Understand why you made a profit or loss together with mentors.
founderLoop.step3Desc: Solve real-world business cases proposed by community entrepreneurs to earn credits.
founderLoop.step4Desc: Develop your skills across 5 key perspectives and advance from Builder to Founder.

skills.title: The 5 Entrepreneurial Perspectives
skills.subtitle: Every decision you make develops real-world business competencies.
skills.marketDesc: Understanding customers, product promotion, and market positioning.
skills.productDesc: Creating value, developing features, and design.
skills.operationsDesc: Efficiency, internal processes, logistics, and team management.
skills.strategyDesc: Long-term vision, competitive analysis, and decision-making under uncertainty.

motherboard.title: Explore the Motherboard
motherboard.subtitle: Click on the motherboard components to discover the secrets of entrepreneurship.
motherboard.cpuDesc: Just like a processor, an entrepreneur must analyze hundreds of variables and make rapid decisions under uncertainty.
motherboard.ramDesc: Day-to-day operations require multitasking. Your RAM represents the capacity to manage resources in real time.
motherboard.gpuDesc: The GPU handles rendering and vision. For a company, this means long-term strategy and anticipating competitive moves.
